title: North African Market Plaza, Djellaba Crowd - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A wide-angle mid-century snapshot capturing a bustling open square or marketplace in North Africa, likely Morocco or Tunisia. Local residents dressed in hooded djellabas and white flowing wraps mingle with individuals in Western-tailored suits. Early post-war automobiles are parked across the center square, flanked by historic masonry walls, an arched entrance, and a minaret standing in the distance under a heavy cloud cover.
